text: Added fmriAR parity fixture suite for PACF helpers, ARMA whitening with runs and censor resets, ACF diagnostics, and fixed AR(1) fit_noise estimation. Added modules/ar/tools/generate_fmriar_parity.R for reproducible constant generation. Verified with sbt -no-colors arJVM/test arJS/test and Rscript modules/ar/tools/generate_fmriar_parity.R.
